arguments: {"test_id": "T1", "per_hypothesis": [{"id": "H1", "verdict": "supported", "why": "[Agent-generated hypothesis; prediction, not validated experimentally] Wild-type Arg28 lies within 4.5 \u00c5 of an organic ligand in 32 of 39 ligand-bound structures that observe it. The inositol-phosphate contacts are 4IP at 2.75 \u00c5 (4 of 6 instances; 1B55 and 1BWN) and 4PT at 2.58 \u00c5 (2Z0P). Negative-control ligands never contact the residue. This supports the claim that Arg28 sits at the ligand site. It does not test the R28H-specific part of H1: the would_refute clause needs a modelled His28 complex with the same ligand, which was not run. Evidence: T1, E6, E16."}, {"id": "H2", "verdict": "unchanged", "why": "[Agent-generated hypothesis; prediction, not validated experimentally] T1 measures ligand contacts, not PH-TH dimer contacts. Its 4.5 \u00c5 ligand measurement does not bear on the inter-protomer interface named in H2's would_refute. Its result gives H2 no support or penalty. Evidence: T1, E7."}, {"id": "H3", "verdict": "unchanged", "why": "[Agent-generated hypothesis; prediction, not validated experimentally] T1 does not measure folding, stability, or backbone dynamics, so it does not bear on H3's ddG or RMSF criteria. Evidence: T1, E13, E14, E15."}], "uncertainty": "The test measures whether any atom of residue 28 is within 4.5 \u00c5 of any organic ligand. It does not measure side-chain-to-phosphate distances, so it does not meet H1's own refutation criterion either way. Many of the ligands are synthetic tetrahydrobenzofuran compounds (A1B6x series), not inositol phosphates; they show that the site is druggable, not that it binds IP4 or PIP3. Only 4IP (1B55, 1BWN) and 4PT (2Z0P) are phosphate-bearing, and the 4PT contact is from a single structure. The R28C structures (6TT2, 6TSE, 1BTK, 6YYF) show zero contacts, but their ligands are mostly ions (ZN, MG) or negative-control ligands, so this is weak evidence about His or Cys at position 28. Crystal contacts with soluble analogues are not measurements of binding by the variant protein, and no structure of R28H exists in this record. Validation still needed: R28 versus R28H modelled complex with 4IP (H1 refutation test), a binding measurement such as ITC or SPR of PH domain R28H against IP4, and a membrane-recruitment assay in cells. Predictions remain unvalidated.\""}
